subject: general
question: Which of the following pairs is not correctly matched (UNESCO Natural Heritage Site and its location)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Elephanta Caves** are incorrectly matched with Karnataka. They are actually located in Maharashtra.
 
• The **Sun Temple** is correctly matched with Odisha.
 
• **Fatehpur Sikri** is correctly matched with Uttar Pradesh.
 
• **Sunderbans National Park** is correctly matched with West Bengal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **UNESCO World Heritage Sites** are landmarks or areas with legal protection by an international convention administered by the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization.
 
• These sites are designated as having **cultural, historical, scientific, or other forms of significance**.
 
• India has a rich heritage with several sites listed under UNESCO, reflecting its diverse culture and history.
